About

You Know Me As Dubbz

South Florida-based entertainment company providing professional DJ services and event production. Established in 2024, we deliver tailored, high-energy music experiences for corporate events, nightlife venues, and private gatherings.

With over 10 years of professional experience, the signature sound blends house, hip-hop, afrobeats, dancehall, top 40, and latin — curated for each unique room.
